Scoring 2 to 3 <arc/>Arc Kills within 10 seconds of each grants 1 Stack of <arc/>Arc Weapon Surge for <pve 11 /> <pvp [6] /> seconds. Maximum of 4 Stacks. <arc/>Arc Kills while at 4 Stacks refresh the buff's duration.

Grants a 75 HP Overshield upon casting the <arc/>Fists of Havoc Super that negates Precision Damage. As long as it does not get fully destroyed, the overshield regenerates over 7 seconds after not receiving damage for 5 seconds.

Scoring Kills with <arc/>Fists of Havoc refunds ?% Super Energy.

Once <arc/>Fists of Havoc ends, it grants 4 Stacks of <arc/>Arc Weapon Surge for <pve 30 /> <pvp [6] /> seconds.
